title: Vibes Components - Company Overview
content: Vibes Components was established in 2014 and began as an elastomeric component manufacturer focused on wire seals before expanding into wiring harness and connector seal manufacturing. The company serves automotive and EV industries and describes itself as IATF-certified. It has introduced in-house compound formulation, R&D, testing and validation, advanced machinery, automatic batching and weighing, and digitized product genealogy tracking and tracing. Public contact details include info@vibescomponents.com and phone numbers +91 2068280724 and +91 7770012885. The manufacturing address is Gat No. 1559/1560, Shelarvasti, Dehu Alandi Road, Chikhali, Pune, Maharashtra 411062.

title: About Vibes Components
content: Vibes Components provides end-to-end engineering support from concept to delivery with R&D, engineering, product design, quick prototyping and Engineering Change Notice support. The company collaborates with testing laboratories, supplier R&D teams and rubber research institutions. Publicly stated infrastructure includes a roughly 10,000 sq. ft. facility across three adjacent plants, around 30 hydraulic moulding machines in the 40 to 250 tonnage range, chemical batch weighing, rubber kneading, rubber mixing mills, post-curing ovens and a quality laboratory. Signature strengths include tool design and development, compound development, infrastructure and capabilities, quality and precision, customization and collaboration.

title: EV Battery & Charger Components
content: Vibes Components manufactures seals and gaskets for electric vehicle applications using materials such as silicone and EPDM. The website describes protection against moisture, dust and contaminants for battery enclosures, cooling systems and electrical connectors, including IP67-compliant sealing solutions. Product areas include flame-retardant silicone rubber components for EV battery cell packs, dampers and cushioning pads, rubber TPU and TPE components with adhesive tapes, over-moulded metal components and busbars, and thermally conductive electrically insulative pads. The company also describes focus areas including thermal conduction, flame retardancy, electrical resistivity and custom solutions for battery packs, power electronics and charging ports.

title: Wire Seals, Connector Seals & Mat Seals
content: Vibes Components manufactures wire seals, connector seals and mat seals using formulated compounds including silicone and NBR. Silicone seal options include oil-bleeding and non-oil-bleeding HCR and LSR. The company states that solutions can be customized for different wire gauges, are validated to SAE USCAR 2 standards, and are designed for dust-tight and temporary water-immersion protection. The website states compatibility with automatic crimping machines such as KOMAX, KODERA and JAM. Raw materials are described as compliant with RoHS, REACH and ELV requirements. The product range also includes dummy seals, gum seals, peripheral seals and mat seals.

title: Engineering Elastomeric Components
content: Vibes Components offers customized elastomeric components using materials including silicone, EPDM, NBR, polyurethane elastomers and TPE. Manufacturing processes listed on the company website include compression moulding, transfer moulding, injection moulding and extrusion. Component types include grommets, boots, bellows, tubes, dampers, metal-to-rubber bonded components, sealants, O-rings, washers, handlebar grips and C-type USB charger caps. Publicly stated material performance themes include ozone resistance, high and low temperature capability, abrasion resistance, electrical insulation and mechanical strength.

title: Engineering & Innovation
content: Vibes Components develops custom elastomer compounds and validates them for application-specific requirements. The website describes the VIBSIL series of flame-retardant silicone compounds for EV battery safety, including V0 40 and V0 60 Shore A grades with UL 94 V0 flammability performance at the stated sample condition. It also describes development work on thermally conductive and electrically insulative silicone materials. VIBMILEX EPDM 60 is described as an EPDM compound focused on abrasion resistance, heat and water resistance, self-lubricating properties and use in compression or transfer moulding with suitable peroxides. The company applies Value Analysis and Value Engineering principles during product development and validation and emphasizes collaborative product development with customers.
